question.worked_solution:
Remember, the order of the vectors in a basis is important.

Notice that 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14274696/assets/f778bc04188da8bf824aab34f770f555a01ceabcc0153afd557577f1c8b14414.svg)

which means that

$$
\mathbf{x} = (-5) \cdot \mathbf{b}_1 + 2 \cdot \mathbf{b}_2
$$
